title: iOS CI runner is pinned by the SDK the apps need
why: Skill ios-apps pins CI to the macos-26 image, but Home says that image has Xcode 26.6 and no iOS 27.1 SDK, and Degen runs xcode-27 with no exemption record. Either the pin is stale or each app needs an exemption form.
source: retrospective 23:27 CST Nov 12; Degen ledger D29; Home triage 23:20 CST
note: Check first: the SDK claim (which Xcode and SDKs the macos-26 image holds) and the runner cost of a newer image. Then pin by the SDK the apps need, or name one exemption form in skill ios-apps. Unverified: the SDK claim.
